transfer.scope: Synthetic structural transfer; exact32 is development only; no ARC or S6 claim

methodology_v2.decision_provenance: Coordinator methodological decision after the r1 development result and before any confirmation evaluation. The owner requested comparison with a fixed library; this document does not attribute a promise of numerical thresholds to the owner.
methodology_v2.fixed_reference: The manual knowledge oracle supplies the same six target macros, demonstration support and dependency structure that acquisition aims to discover. The condition id remains fixed for API compatibility. It pays construction and verification costs. Its role is fixed_oracle_reference; it is not a learned system.
methodology_v2.fixed_required: Require zero paired supported-case accuracy regressions and learned total work <= 105% of fixed total work, including acquisition. These are separate required gates. Noninferiority permits at most 5% extra total cost; it is not superiority.
methodology_v2.fixed_descriptive: Retain learned_vs_fixed with its original strict >=5% total-work saving and zero paired-loss definition. Report it even when false. It is descriptive and is not a required closure gate in V2.
methodology_v2.memory_required: Against BOTH empty and the unchanged size-matched irrelevant semantic control, require >=5% total-work saving AND >=5% semantic-work saving, including acquisition and every accounting stage, with zero paired supported-case losses. Metadata-only savings cannot satisfy the semantic gates.
methodology_v2.semantic_work: Operational ledger partition, not a claim of abstract reasoning or CPU time: all charged work except the exact metadata_work_categories above. Search-state hashing, prefix indexes, execution, evidence replay, generation and comparison remain charged. Categories not explicitly listed remain semantic. Metadata work is still included in all total-cost gates.
methodology_v2.metametric_differences: Summary reports treatment-minus-control differences for evaluation and all-in semantic, metadata and total work, plus evaluation_saving_is_metadata_only. Negative means less learner work. The r1 difference of 1496 units per case versus fixed was entirely JSON/hash metadata, not less search or execution.
methodology_v2.closure_meaning: Passing the explicit required_gates supports bounded structural transfer and memory efficiency versus empty/irrelevant controls, with accuracy and cost noninferiority to the manual oracle. It does not establish superiority to the manual oracle, an ARC score, general statistical independence or AGI.
methodology_v2.unchanged_execution: No change to generators, cases, seeds, 72 confirmation cases / 504 condition rows, acquisition, libraries, verifications, grammar, beam, budgets, solver defaults or query-label isolation. V1 case identifiers are retained because execution and input generation are unchanged.
methodology_v2.audit_and_history: New reports and audits use v2 schemas and recompute the cost partition and explicit gate policy from raw receipts. Audit V1 reports with their archived V1 sources/contract; never reinterpret or overwrite r1 as V2. TRANSFER-CLOSURE.md describes the original V1 implementation; this section documents the V2 measurement amendment. Tests and CPU evaluation remain deferred to the parent background runner.

prior_development.interpretation: Known negative under the original strict contract. A valid audit certifies its receipts, not scientific superiority. V2 is a later measurement decision, not a correction of this result.

open_tasks.observation: R1 pack_rotate_scale solved 1/2 development cases. Beam pruning and first-retained-tier consensus remain declared limitations; investigate in a later work item. This amendment adds no solution, hypothesis, search change or accuracy-threshold change.

transfer.accounting: Per-arm total includes all acquisition attempts, construction, evidence revalidation, state freezing, search, failed work, input/state hashing and evaluator generation/verification. Shared evaluation generation is charged in full to each arm. Physical run work counts it once. Audit/replay work and wall/process time are reported separately; logical units are not FLOPs or energy.
transfer.selection: All hypotheses in the first matching retained tier must agree on every query. Beam/state reduction is explicit and does not certify the entire DSL. Budget/candidate exhaustion always abstains. Library calls are learned priors, never query verification.
transfer.freeze_policy: Write this file before evaluation. Confirmation accepts only these settings. Any change after seeing confirmation requires a new contract version and disjoint seeds; retain old receipts. Freeze full sources externally before invoking confirmation.

curriculum.scope: finite largest-object directional recoloring grammar, optionally followed by rot90/fliplr/flipud; synthetic held-out scene styles, not ARC/S6 or open-ended invention
curriculum.unit_of_inference: independent acquisition run, with all three arms paired within run

learning_curve.utility: For each arm and run, arithmetic mean of exact evaluation accuracy after each of the three teacher queries; normalized discrete AUC, no zero-query endpoint or trapezoidal weighting
learning_curve.pairing: Reuse the same evaluation inputs at every prefix; cases and prefixes remain nested within one acquisition run, never independent replicates
learning_curve.feedback: Prefix predictions use only the current frozen surviving hypotheses; evaluation labels and correctness never enter subsequent selection or learning
learning_curve.final_endpoint: Final accuracy and final regressions remain safeguards; final accuracy gain is descriptive only and is not a V2 superiority claim

selection.adaptive: maximum number of disagreeing live hypothesis pairs; stable input-order tie break; no labels or witness
selection.random: uniform input index from a separate deterministic public selection stream
selection.sequential: first input in an IID, difficulty-unordered pool
selection.teacher: external to actor; selected acquisition label only, one query per round per arm

budget.shared: execute each hypothesis on every public input exactly once per paired run; immutable prediction table shared by all arms, physically charged once
budget.matched: identical actual hypothesis prediction tables, three label queries and full label-comparison opportunities; identical evaluation prediction/adjudication opportunities after every prefix; zero arm-specific hypothesis executions
budget.unmatched: actual selector overhead is counted, never padded or declared equal; bounded-overhead gate can fail
budget.comparison: per-arm standalone-equivalent cost = common preparation + that arm's actual work; physical total = common preparation + sum of arm work
budget.units: logical operations including rendered cells, DSL work, prediction serialization, label comparisons, selection, teacher copies and evaluation; not FLOPs, wall time or joules

acceptance.bootstrap: deterministic paired-run percentile bootstrap; primary utility, absolute total-cost delta and relative overhead jointly resampled; all prefixes and cases remain within their run; final accuracy comparison is descriptive
acceptance.promotion: none; closure success requires every gate, including cost; do not tune on confirmation

curriculum.preexecution_design_revision: V1 replaced zero incremental cost with at most 5 percent total-work overhead after coordinator static review within authorized scope, before V1 execution. That numeric threshold was not an explicit user instruction. The earlier change was not post-result threshold tuning.

v2_revision.authorized: 2026-10-10, after audited development r1 and before any confirmation execution
v2_revision.reason: Development r1: all arms 16/16 final successes across four independent runs; eleven of twelve arms identified a single hypothesis after one query and the remaining arm after two. Final accuracy gain was zero; V1's final-superiority objective was not demonstrated and is refuted for this observed development cohort.
v2_revision.change: Measure accuracy at every existing query prefix and gate learning utility rather than claim improved final precision. This is an explicitly outcome-informed development revision, not V1 preregistration or confirmation success.
v2_revision.preserved: 32 paired confirmation runs, three teacher queries, grammar, pools, generator, selection algorithms, seed partition and reserved uninspected confirmation seeds, work ceiling and five-percent overhead bounds
v2_revision.custody: Retain archived V1 sources, contract, development report and valid audit; freeze V2 before new checks/campaigns. No seed search or pool redesign. No claim that V2 will pass.

budget_rules.allocation: identical native steps and logical-work limits per case per condition
budget_rules.work: Budget.consume reservations: reset, validation, localization, map updates, decisions, planning edges/nodes, goal/route matching, candidate information rays and native steps
budget_rules.environment_cost: native reset/step calls plus measured wall seconds; work units do not purport to count external-library CPU instructions
budget_rules.replay_cost: separate identical execution limit per case/condition, plus separately reported receipt validation work and wall seconds
budget_rules.instrumentation: snapshot polling and journal serialization are passive overhead, not actor work or policy input
budget_rules.exhaustion: retain actual steps and native terminal outcomes; never drop an exhausted case or silently refund work
budget_rules.instrument_error: journal and propagate; no conversion into agent failure or denominator exclusion

memory.initial: empty for every case and condition; no cross-case learning or holdout persistence
memory.learning: observation-acquired map, transition counts, observed contradictions, supported subgoals
memory.pose: relative to episode origin, estimated from actions and registration of visible static landmarks
memory.unseen: unknown; no full-grid rendering, no absolute hidden coordinates
memory.no_memory: discard prior map, visit counts and evidence on every observation; retain task progress and motor odometry
memory.no_planning: retain observed memory but use only local reactions, no graph or information search

native_goal_phrases: get to the green goal square
use the key to open the door and then get to the goal
mission_grammar.location_scope: initial agent frame; location-sensitive built-in profile is the single-room BabyAI-PickupLoc task
mission_grammar.ambiguity: record multiple observed candidates and unseen alternatives; any satisfying match is legal only if the external verifier agrees
mission_grammar.unsupported: reject unparsed or overlong instructions; no LLM or arbitrary code evaluation
mission_grammar.operator_missions: native BabyAI verifier bound to existing matching objects, or equivalent native MiniGrid goal; never relabel a different MiniGrid objective

sandbox.seed_rule: base_seed + flat_case_index * 101; interval validated; never passed to actor; seed0 fixed for passive policy only

gates.superiority: informative success wins minus losses >= 1 versus EACH fixed/passive/no_memory/no_planning control; costs reported independently, no cost-only promotion
gates.closure: confirmation cohort, all families/modes, exact contract budget, >=8 cases/family, correctness and measured-success gates, all four superiority comparisons
gates.failure_policy: keep zeroes and negatives; no denominator changes, seed filtering, retries or thresholds changed after confirmation

sandbox.replay: new native environment, same pinned code/config/seed, full public observations, action decisions, evidence, logical costs and external verdict compared; timings excluded
sandbox.journal: existing echo5.trace.Recorder.write(kind=..., **facts); sandbox_reset, sandbox_step, sandbox_stop, sandbox_error, sandbox_case_start, sandbox_adjudication, sandbox_instrument_error
limitations: No episodes or CPU tests executed during programming; no performance or closure result is claimed.
Explicit Python object ownership/data-flow boundary, not process isolation against hostile actor code.
Symbolic native mechanics and finite grammar are supplied; learned memory means accumulated observation evidence, not trained policy weights.
Pose ambiguity and moving obstacles can invalidate remembered spatial estimates; all map positions remain labelled estimates.
Candidate identity is descriptive and spatial; visually identical relocated objects are not assigned privileged native identities.
Confirmation holds out seeds, combinations and task rules from development; parser/mechanics deliberately implement those supported rule families beforehand.
Local native task adaptation is not an official MiniGrid/BabyAI benchmark score, general language understanding, physical validation or statistical superiority proof.

mission.scope: New software and Gazebo/PX4 SITL episodes only; no HIL, hardware or flight certification

software.audit_criteria: Independent evaluator-world consequences and POWER/SAFE/gateway reconstruction from each row trace, recalculated successes/costs/denominators, plus exact logical replay in a fresh process; independently check current-evidence path witnesses, action binding, confirmed gateway consequences, causal history, reasoning usage, and declared prior provenance
software.determinism: Same config gives identical logical rows; software ACKs, telemetry and consequences are explicitly synthetic

sitl.network: none; inherited MAVLink UDP port 14540 and Gazebo discovery exist only inside each container
sitl.determinism: Pinned image, sources, generated world, config and physics seed; no promise of exact floating point replay
sitl.collision_measure: Swept horizontal 400 mm body envelope against generated 3 m obstacle boxes; private Gazebo pose timestamps; no contact-force claim

private_pose_instrumentation.method: Inherited Gazebo dynamic_pose callback, original pose timestamps, bounded queue, drained independent writer
private_pose_instrumentation.missing_samples: Any overflow, invalid pose, timestamp regression, incomplete writer or gap above truth_max_gap_ns invalidates the receipt; no interpolation
private_pose_instrumentation.separation: Private evaluator artifact only; never sent to actor or policy
private_pose_instrumentation.historical_poll_log: Preserved for original world-intervention records and diagnostics, not used as the dense pose stream

priors.effects: Two declared synthetic unit displacements per horizontal action; no reward training
priors.power: Declared conservative simulated-charge prior, not fitted from flights; n=8 is the inherited model schema requirement, not eight measured samples

acceptance.software_correctness: All scheduled rows accounted for, zero collisions/reserve violations/unsafe commands, every adverse condition exercised, positive static task completion; separate from SITL; default new reasoning must be called and execute through the independent gateway in nominal principal rows
acceptance.mission_success: Externally observed target plus RGB marker, observed return home, disarmed, reserve >=40, no safety violation
acceptance.adverse_success: Low energy returns/lands safely; stale sensor or lost agent produces latched SAFE veto, no post-veto sends/heartbeats, observed disarm; remains a mission-completion failure
acceptance.sitl_complete: All required condition/mode rows have valid external evidence and independent audit; normal static/contradiction missions succeed and adverse conditions satisfy their safety criterion; independent raw-path and execution-consequence audit must establish new reasoning actually used in principal nominal rows
acceptance.advantage: More paired task successes than conventional with zero paired losses, or equal successes and strictly lower total logical work; ties do not demonstrate advantage
acceptance.promotion: No automatic ECHO-5, S6, real flight, HIL or hardware green; physical and software evidence never substitute for one another

reasoning.representation: echo5.grounding.Object/Scene and same_row/same_col relations on public admitted cells; requested target is not an observed marker
reasoning.effects: declared_nominal_prior; no synthetic acquisition receipts or trained-model claim
reasoning.graph_exclusion: unknown or not currently admitted; not an assertion that a wall exists
reasoning.latency_boundary: default path projects once inside inherited MissionAgent; hook consumes already projected/registered frame only after POWER
reasoning.consequences: Actual ordered proposal, unique matching send, accepted ACK, three distinct settled samples and arrival required for execution credit; terminal outcomes and unresolved actions retained. Only outcomes delivered in a confirmed subsequent actor reply count toward its causal history.
reasoning.independence: MissionAgent POWER/return/inspection plus independently replayed SAFE/gateway remain authoritative
reasoning.default_path_gate: every principal nominal row must have reasoner_calls>0 and reasoner_executed>0; a plan_source string alone is insufficient

information_gathering.trigger: New planner has no path supported by the current frame, or a return step lacks fresh independent admission
information_gathering.actions: Existing canonical yaw-only INSPECT WSPs; no translation into unknown space
information_gathering.cost: All perception, probe decisions, execution, battery and logical work charged; second projection only for an otherwise-unresolved return step
information_gathering.priority: POWER land/energy decisions and external SAFE/gateway stay authoritative; never clear a prior stop or energy-return latch
information_gathering.evidence: Current path failure or blocked return neighbour, index, cumulative count, stationary prediction and independent reserve check
information_gathering.evaluation: New development and reserved confirmation; no reclassification of earlier failures

mission.seed_separation: Development [seed, seed+cases-1] must not intersect its complete reserved confirmation interval; checked before worlds/processes and by auditors.
mission.calibration_status: Confirmation 861703..861708 is exposed and preserved negative. New engineering calibration: EKF2_ACC_NOISE=0.7 versus default0.35, keeping EKF2_ACC_B_NOISE=0.01, sensors/world noise, budgets and all measurement limits. Hypothesis: increase prediction uncertainty to improve GNSS correction of persistent vertical-velocity error. Must pass six fresh development episodes and independent audit before full development and a new confirmation 971809..971814. Exception recovery observes autopilot disarm after heartbeat cancellation but preserves the original failed outcome. No cognitive-learning claim.
